macros.name: liststrut
macros.doc: The command raises first line of next text block at the baseline of previous.

macros.name: startnumber
macros.doc: The \startnumber allows you to divide tabenum environment and restart with necessary counter.

macros.name: tabenumindent
macros.doc: The \tabenumindent command sets left margin of tabenum environment.

envs.name: subtabenum
envs.doc: The second level of equations/exersizes list subtabenum based on tabular environment.

envs.name: tabenum
envs.doc: The tabenum environment prints short items aligned in columns.
